senses.gloss: m. (denom. of בורגין) keeper or resident of a station house.
units: Midr. Till. to Ps. X, 1 when it grew dark, בא לו הבורגן (read … ני) the burgani came to him.
Ib. חזר … אצל הב׳ he turned back and came to the burgani.

<cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Avodah Zarah 4:1:9">Y. Ab. Zar. IV, 43ᵈ</cite> <he>אתא גביה בורגנה</he> ed. Krot. (oth. ed. <cite ref="B00343"><he>בורגנרה</he></cite>, read <cite ref="B00342"><he>בורגני</he></cite> or <he>בורגרי</he>) a station guardsman (burgarius) came to him.
